final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_statuses FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT status_counts.archstat, status_counts.cnt, CAST(status_counts.cnt AS REAL) / totals.total_count as share, 1.0 / totals.num_statuses as avg_share FROM status_counts CROSS JOIN totals) SELECT archstat, cnt, share, share - avg_share as above_avg FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
